text.p: Rubbermaid Inc said on Thursday it has completed the acquisition of Graco Children's Products Inc for $320 million.
Rubbermaid said the deal, which is accounted for as a purchase, is not expected to dilute earnings.
Graco's infant furniture line will complement Rubbermaid's existing products for children, such as its Little Tikes toys, furniture and play equipment. Graco's 1996 sales are
expected to be $270 million, Rubbermaid said.
There is no product overlap between the two companies and the merger is not expected to lead to job cuts, Rubbermaid director of corporate communications Lorrie Paul Crum said.
Rubbermaid expects to help expand Graco to reach international customers and aid its manufacturing, Crum said.
The companies will integrate logistics and information systems, Crum said.
